summary: Hess Midstream is a qualifying infrastructure operator and a former GIP investment, but GIP completed a full exit on May 30, 2025 and no longer held any direct or indirect Company, Partnership or GP interest. Chevron acquired Hess on July 18, 2025 and now controls the GP chain with approximately 37.965% as-exchanged economics. Passive BlackRock-managed public securities do not restore qualifying direct ownership.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Any current sub-5% passive BlackRock-managed Class A exposure is not publicly disclosed and is nonqualifying.
